title: StepAudio3 Series Model Launch: Five Models Simultaneously Released on the Open Platform
excerpt: StepZenith officially launched the StepAudio3 series of models today, including StepAudio3Realtime, StepAudio3ASR, StepAudio3TTS, StepAudio3Gen, and StepAudio3M
content_html:
StepZenith officially launched the StepAudio3 series of models today, including StepAudio3Realtime, StepAudio3ASR, StepAudio3TTS, StepAudio3Gen, and StepAudio3Music. All five models have been released on the StepZenith Open Platform, with multiple models ranking first globally in the Artificial Analysis rankings. This series covers scenarios such as human-level voice generation, complete audio generation, real-time voice interaction, complex voice understanding, and music creation.

Among them, StepAudio3Realtime supports native full-duplex real-time conversation, capable of understanding semantics, tone, emotion, paralanguage, and ambient sounds simultaneously, and supports parallel reasoning and voice generation, Tool Call, and asynchronous execution of long tasks. It achieved a comprehensive score of 98.9% in the Artificial Analysis Conversational Dynamics ranking, ranking first globally; its voice reasoning accuracy reached 99.7%, also ranking first globally.

StepAudio3ASR integrates speech recognition and large model context understanding capabilities, supporting Chinese, English, dialects, mixed Chinese and English, long audio, and professional scenarios such as medical, legal, and financial fields, with a WER of only 1.7%, tied for first globally. StepAudio3TTS enhances vocal tone, intonation, rhythm, pauses, and paralanguage expressions such as laughter, hesitation, and stuttering, and supports streaming generation, targeting real-time voice interaction.

Additionally, StepAudio3Gen can uniformly generate character voices, sound effects, ambient sounds, and background music, and supports multi-character and voice timing control; StepAudio3Music supports song creation, a cappella accompaniment, cover songs, and multi-round creation based on ABC notation, allowing natural language control over musical style, melody, rhythm, instruments, and emotion. Overall, StepAudio3 is expanding the capabilities of voice models from single recognition or generation to complete audio content production and real-time intelligent interaction.
